subject: Multi-choice selectInput refreshes each time an option is selected

messages.author: 12ba4fcf8526f1d6
messages.subject: Multi-choice selectInput refreshes each time an option is selected
parts:
We created a multi selectInput dynamically using renderUI, the selectInput refreshes each time an option selected. Hence, not able to select all the options at one go.

Code:
selectInput("varMisc", "Misc",choiceNames, multiple = TRUE,selected=input$varMisc)
